0022600213.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home, 0-3 on the road, currently on a two-game win streak) host the LA Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road, on a one-game win streak), with Phoenix third in the Pacific and five games back and LA fourth, 6.5 back. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while LA is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and their last meeting was on February 1, 2026 in Phoenix, when the Suns lost 117-93.
